segment.source: <end>

segment.source: My apologies, $(#sir/ma'am). Our source has just confirmed that you have, in fact, joined another major Core City organization. Due to strict rules here in Praetorian Security, I must decline your request.<end>

segment.source: A bunch of idiots you are. ::Leave.::<end>

segment.source: You're clear. Go up these stairs, then take the first left. There you'll find Lieutenant Stratford. Talk to him and he'll explain everything you need to know. <end>

segment.source: Nope, I come from SGS.<end>
segment.target: Nope, I come from SGS.<end>

segment.source: Yes, I am familiar with SGS. Praetorian Security is the largest defensive force in Core City. Our duty is to protect all those who live in Core City from internal and external threats.<end>
